title: Attributes of God
definition: The attributes of God are the perfections revealed in Scripture that describe who God is and how He acts. They include His holiness, love, righteousness, wisdom, power, truth, goodness, mercy, faithfulness, and sovereignty.
summary: God's attributes are not separate parts of Him, as though He were assembled from different qualities. God is perfectly and eternally all that He is. His love is holy love. His justice is righteous justice. His mercy is wise mercy. His sovereignty is never separated from His goodness. The attributes of God teach believers to trust His character, worship His greatness, fear His holiness, and rest in His faithfulness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reveals the character of God in personal fullness. In Christ we see the holiness, compassion, truth, righteousness, mercy, wisdom, and saving love of God displayed before us.

studySections.heading: God Is Holy
studySections.content: God is morally perfect and completely set apart from sin. His holiness calls His people to reverence, repentance, and worship.

studySections.heading: God Is Love
studySections.content: God's love is not sentimental weakness but holy, covenantal, self-giving goodness. His love is demonstrated supremely in the giving of His Son.

studySections.heading: God Is Faithful
studySections.content: God keeps His promises and remains true to His Word. His faithfulness gives believers confidence in prayer, endurance, and obedience.
